text.en: 1. This Order is the Housing and Development (Precincts for Lift Upgrading Works) Order 2022 and comes into operation on 16 November 2022.

heading.en: Declaration of precinct for lift upgrading works

text.en: 2. The parts of the housing estate of the Board described in the Schedule are declared to be a precinct for the purpose of carrying out lift upgrading works.

THE SCHEDULE
All that part of the housing estate of the Board at Pasir Ris Street 11 comprised in Lot number 01707T in Mukim 31 and on which Apartment Block 128 is erected, and which is more particularly delineated in the Plan.
THE PLAN
PASIR RIS STREET 11
